rationale: The baseline is already a single scalar 32-bit load/store with no arithmetic on the copied value, so bit preservation is exact. The workload includes many small and irregular shapes; a 2D layout maps one thread to one output element and avoids the integer division/modulo in the baseline. The kernel uses uint2 thread_position_in_grid and predicates both dimensions, preserving all output padding and avoiding out-of-bounds accesses. Threads=[16,16] gives 256 threads per group and is valid for both small and large cases.
